title: An agent can change what it made: fonts, captions, titles, effects and sound
goal: When someone asks Ask to change something already on the canvas or timeline (make the heading bolder, turn the captions yellow, soften the glow, lower the music), the agent can do it, the same way a person does it in the panel. Today it can make most things but cannot change many of their settings afterwards.
notes: Source: the-agent-coverage-check-counts-panel-controls-a (2026-11-10). Run Scripts/test.sh --filter AgentReachTests and read the count test's printout; every not-yet line in Tests/PhotonzCoreTests/AgentReachTests.swift panelTable/rowTable names what is missing. Biggest groups (panel + menus): component copies 27, saved styles/lines 27, captions 24, measurement look 15, titles once made 15, effect settings 13, sound 12, text font/reveal 12, charts 10, motion rows 9, placement 8. Likely shape: extend set_layer (font, weight, tracking, leading, alignment, blendMode, effects[]), a set_captions_look tool, a set_sound tool (volume, gainDB, fadeCurve, eq), a restyle_title tool. Lower panelNotYetPin / rowNotYetPin as lines move.
acceptance: The panel not-yet pin in AgentReachTests (213 on 2026-11-10) drops by at least 60, each control moved to the agent tool field that now sets it

A text layer's font, weight, tracking, leading and alignment, an added effect's settings, captions' look, a sound's volume and gain, and a made title's theme and background are each set by an agent tool and proved by a unit test
Each new tool field changes the document in one undo step, checked the way Scripts/agent-commands-drill.mjs checks commands
The counts table in docs/design/agent-mcp.md is updated from the test's printout
